_comment: Curated quick-add list shown in the Models tab. Every URL here is verified downloadable (ranged-GET 206) and sizeBytes is the exact Content-Range total as of 2026-05-29. Users can paste any URL too; this just gets popular weights one click closer. Seeded to APPDATA on first run, then user-editable.

categories.name: LLM (GGUF)
categories.description: Local chat / completion models for llama.cpp + Ollama. Q4_K_M is the sweet spot for quality-vs-size; pick by how much VRAM you have.

models.name: Qwen3 0.6B (Q8_0)
models.description: Tiny + fast. Great as a spec-decode draft model or for low-VRAM machines.

models.name: Gemma 3 4B IT (Q4_K_M)
models.description: Google's small multimodal-capable chat model. Fits comfortably in 6 GB VRAM.

models.name: Qwen3 4B (Q4_K_M)
models.description: Strong small general model with a thinking mode. ~2.3 GB.

models.name: Qwen2.5-Coder 7B (Q4_K_M)
models.description: Best-in-class open coding model at this size. ~4.4 GB, fits in 8 GB VRAM.

models.name: Llama 3.1 8B Instruct (Q4_K_M)
models.description: Meta's tuned 8B chat model — a reliable general-purpose default. ~4.6 GB.

models.name: Gemma 3 12B IT (Q4_K_M)
models.description: Larger Gemma 3 for stronger reasoning. ~6.8 GB — wants 12 GB+ VRAM.

categories.name: Embeddings
categories.description: Text embedding models for RAG / semantic search.

models.name: Nomic Embed Text v1.5 (F16)
models.description: Open 768-d embedding model with long context. ~0.26 GB.
